label: perinatal lethality
defn: death anytime within the perinatal period (Mus: E18.5 through postnatal day 1)

label: embryonic lethality before implantation
defn: death anytime between fertilization and implantation (Mus: E0 to less than E4.5)

label: embryonic lethality between implantation and somite formation
defn: death anytime between the point of implantation and somite formation (Mus: E4.5 to less than E8)

label: embryonic lethality between somite formation and embryo turning
defn: death anytime between somite formation and the initiation of embryo turning (Mus: E8 to less than E9)

label: embryonic lethality during organogenesis
defn: death anytime between embryo turning and the completion of organogenesis (Mus: E9-9.5 to less than E14)

label: lethality throughout fetal growth and development
defn: death anytime between the completion of organogenesis and birth (Mus: E14 to approximately E18.5)

label: embryonic lethality at implantation
defn: death due to failure of implantation (Mus: E4.5)

label: embryonic lethality between implantation and placentation
defn: death anytime between the point of implantation and the initiation of placentation (Mus: E4.5 to less than E9)

label: lethality during fetal growth through weaning
defn: death anytime between the completion of organogenesis and weaning age (Mus: E14 to approximately 3 weeks of age)

label: perinatal lethality, complete penetrance
defn: death of all organisms of a given genotype in a population within the perinatal period (Mus: E18.5 through postnatal day 1)

label: perinatal lethality, incomplete penetrance
defn: the appearance of lower than Mendelian ratios of organisms of a given genotype due to death of some, but not all of the organisms within the perinatal period (Mus: E18.5 through postnatal day 1)

label: embryonic lethality at implantation, complete penetrance
defn: death of all organisms of a given genotype in a population at the point of implantation (Mus: E4.5)
